title: Before We Die (white)
descriptionHtml:
This is a deeply ambiguous print, and the words are taken from a book called 24/7 by Jonathan Crary. “The absolute abdication of responsibility for living is indicated by the titles of the many bestselling guides that tell us, with grim fatality, the 1000 movies to see before we die, the 100 tourist destinations to visit before we die, the 500 books to read before we die.” Ambiguous, but also kind of pretty with the sparkling diamond dust.
 
Available in both black and white, and made with diamond dust milled from Reichenbach glass.

 

1 colour diamond dust screenprint.

Edition of 77 prints

Paper size: 280 x 280mm

Print size: 230 x 235mm

Printed on acid-free Colorplan Ice White 700gsm Plain

title: It's Not Too Late (white)
descriptionHtml:
Arguably one of the more upbeat prints we have made at the Manufactory, this print can nonetheless be interpreted in a number of ways; either cheerily or gloomily, and its message will alter in tone depending on how you feel at any given moment. But also - what, precisely, is not too late? What is ‘it’? See? It’s a philosophical conundrum. And also it’s kind of pretty with the sparkling diamond dust.
 
Available in both black and white, and made with diamond dust milled from Reichenbach glass.

1 colour diamond dust screenprint.

Edition of 77 prints

Paper size: 280 x 280mm

Print size: 230 x 235mm

Printed on acid-free Colorplan Ice White 700gsm Plain
